description.message: A robot that reviews each site's cookies and sums them up, and helps you check suspicious messages. All in your browser.

intro.message: Review the text before taking it to Guardian.

note.message: We don’t read your inbox. Only the text you select is read when you press the button. Nothing is saved or sent automatically.

copied.message: Text copied. Paste it into Guardian and press Analyze when you are ready.

empty.message: Select text on the page or paste it here first.

error.message: We couldn’t read this page. Copy the message and paste it here.

copyError.message: We couldn’t copy it. Copy the text manually and open rastropro.com/guardian.

truncated.message: The first 4,000 characters were selected. Review the text.

limit.message: Maximum 4,000 characters. Remove codes, passwords or banking details before continuing.

cookiesEmpty.message: Open a regular site (http or https) to see its cookies.

bubblePrivacy.message: Everything is checked in your browser. We don't send your cookies anywhere.

rejected.message: Done: I clicked “reject” on the cookie banner. I'll count again in a moment.

rejectMissing.message: I can't find a reject button on this page.

blockHint.message: Cuts ads that follow you and companies that trade in profiles. If a site stops working, turn it off.
